status: Requested generic interface, failed measured adoption criteria

protocol.user_constraint: No actionness or architecture-specific auxiliary signal. Main algorithm inputs only interval posterior, box tracks and spatial box hypotheses/validity; generic core uses only NumPy.
protocol.question: Can local spatial uncertainty improve expected tube-overlap decisions without pretending to predict event semantics?
protocol.candidate: Same13 existing interval decisions, de-duplicated. For each candidate execute the same frozen BoxFixed spatial DP; algorithm can accept any interval/trajectory proposal bank.
protocol.quality: Per node uniform mean box IoU of the candidate track with available ERef/forward/backward complete-box hypotheses. Consensus is a spatial-quality proxy, not calibrated true IoU, identity or event probability; duplicate/correlated hypotheses are not assumed independent.
protocol.score: Sum over native temporal hypotheses q(s,e) of physical integral of candidate spatial quality on candidate intersection hypothesis, divided by temporal union. No reward weights or temperature.
protocol.controls: Constant quality1 exactly recovers old temporal utility/incumbent; fixed-baseline track isolates temporal changes; per-candidate mean quality removes alignment; fixed half-video quality shift preserves histogram; same-query prior/random controls match intervention queries.
protocol.exposure: All128 have repeated development exposure. Earlier failure cases inform design, so no untouched confirmation claim.
protocol.budget: Single fixed generic structural trial; no parameter search, new backbone/head/decoder/expert/GPU/updates. CPU one thread/nice15.
protocol.adoption: HC64 t>=0/fullv>0/fixedv>0 and ExpectedTube better t than ShiftedQuality; severe Source-relative v losses<=baseline+2. Both32 groups t>=0 and fullv>0; equal-domain pooled v lower95>0. No production switch during active full.
